# A deep EC P-256 chain for the issuer-lookup depth-bound test: root_cert (self-signed, serial 1) -> inter_1_cert .. inter_5_cert (CA:TRUE,
# serials 2..6, each issued by the one before) -> leaf_cert (serial 7, CN/SAN=localhost, EKU serverAuth, issued by inter_5_cert). The leaf sits five
# CAs below the root, one more than a built path may hold. Validity 2020-01-01..2099-12-31, all ecdsa-with-SHA256, keys not stored.
# Generated with OpenSSL 3.2.1 (openssl ca -selfsign / -startdate 20200101000000Z -enddate 20991231000000Z; MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL='*'):
#   openssl ecparam -name prime256v1 -genkey -noout -out X.key   (each certificate)
#   openssl req -new -key X.key -subj "/CN=<name>" -out X.csr    (names: TlsLib Depth Root, TlsLib Depth Issuer 1..5, localhost)
#   openssl ca -batch -config ca.cnf -selfsign -in root.csr -keyfile root.key -startdate NB -enddate NA -extfile ca.ext -notext -out root.pem
#   openssl ca -batch -config ca.cnf -in X.csr -cert <issuer>.pem -keyfile <issuer>.key -startdate NB -enddate NA -extfile ca.ext -notext -out X.pem
#     ca.cnf: [ca] default_ca=c / [c] database=index.txt new_certs_dir=. serial=serial.txt default_md=sha256 policy=p unique_subject=no / [p] commonName=supplied
#     ca.ext: basicConstraints=critical,CA:true / keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign / subjectKeyIdentifier=hash / authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid
#     leaf.ext: basicConstraints=CA:false / keyUsage=critical,digitalSignature / extendedKeyUsage=serverAuth / subjectAltName=DNS:localhost /
#               subjectKeyIdentifier=hash / authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid
#   openssl verify -CAfile root.pem -untrusted inter.pem leaf.pem   (OK);  openssl x509 -in X.pem -outform DER | xxd -p   (each field)
root_
inter_1_
inter_2_
inter_3_
inter_4_
inter_5_
leaf_
